name: Foxglove TV

ring.prompt: Foxglove TV member services. Calls are recorded for quality. Please hold for the options.

menu.prompt: For billing and payments, press one. For help with the app, press two. To cancel a membership, including after a bereavement, press three.
menu.wrongKeyPrompt: Sorry, that didn't come through. Please pick from the menu again.

holdAnnouncement: Thanks for holding — we'll be right with you.

clerk.greeting: Hi, this is Cormac at Foxglove. I'm sorry you're calling in these circumstances. Can I take the member's full name and the date they passed away?

turns.reprompt: Sorry — just the name on the membership and the date, whenever you're ready.

documents: none — we don't ask for paperwork to close a membership
outcome.closing: That's the membership cancelled straight away, and this month's charge is refunded to the card. Your reference is {REF}. Take good care.

quirk: No paperwork at all — cancels and refunds in a single turn.
